correctness.rationale: Proof verifies all nonnegative powers for the ambient identity, the exact dichotomy \(arphi(p)\) versus one generator, every functional-digraph component and the height/period EGF with Möbius inversion. Exhaustive labeled-submonoid and independent series checks agree through degree six; cycle-type computations agree and extend through degree eighteen. These finite checks are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Counting actual embedded cyclic submonoids is a motivated separate natural invariant from the known abstract isomorphism-type count. The formula distinguishes individual power-generator collisions at precisely classified functional-digraph heights, provides complete exact height/period distributions for all degrees, and yields a sharp exponentially small collision probability. The theorem is mathematically structural and global, not a handful of routine finite cases; no claim that its auxiliary EGF or standard singularity analysis was previously unknown.
